setup:cloud-flash-deepseek.title: Cloud Flash + DeepSeek
setup:cloud-flash-deepseek.summary: Cloud Flash, polished by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: fixes more misheard terms, about as fast. Audio is sent to the cloud when you stop.
setup:cloud-flash-deepseek.backupNote: The smaller model gets more technical terms wrong.

setup:cloud-flash.title: Cloud Flash
setup:cloud-flash.summary: Fastest cloud model — text in about half a second. Handles English mixed into Chinese. Audio is sent to the cloud when you stop.
setup:cloud-flash.backupNote: The smaller model gets more technical terms wrong.
